correctness.rationale: Automorphism averaging preserves both sums and yields invariant pseudometric parameters x,y,z,w with triangle bounds 0≤z≤2w, x≤2 min{z,w}, y≤2w. Scale w=1, maximize x,y, and reduce objective R(t) to one variable t=z. On [0,1] derivative sign is a²b(4a−b−3), on [1,2] derivative negative; exactly t=1 shortest-path or t=0 collapsed-star branches maximize, with equality segment at b=4a−3. For L1, each two-equal-part cut with u,v points obeys W−((a−1)/a)U=(u−v)²/a²≥0. This excludes shortest-path W=1,U=2 for a≥3, and compactness of finite cut cone plus invariant uniqueness makes the gap STRICT, not just unattained. For b≥threshold an explicit coordinate ℓ1 star attains collapsed branch. Fresh exact rational grid and all two-block count cuts a=3..8 corroborate signs/identity. Independently verify triangle constraint sufficiency includes all triangle orbit types.
